source: Latency is the delay between initiating an access and having its result available to the dependent work. A system can have high bandwidth while an individual access still has substantial latency. GPUs tolerate this partly by keeping many independent operations in flight and scheduling other work while some requests wait.
zh: 延迟是启动访问和将其结果提供给相关工作之间的延迟。系统可以具有高带宽，而个人访问仍然具有相当大的延迟。 GPU 通过保持许多独立操作的运行并在某些请求等待时安排其他工作来部分容忍这种情况。
